answer:
FINAL: Beef Wellington by Marla on Allrecipes meets both requirements: 4.7 out of 5 stars and 250 reviews (365 ratings).

Main ingredients (8 servings):
- 2½ lb beef tenderloin
- 6 tbsp butter total
- 1 onion, chopped
- ½ cup fresh mushrooms, sliced
- 2 oz liver pâté
- Salt and pepper
- 17.5 oz frozen puff pastry, thawed
- 1 large egg yolk, beaten
- 10.5 oz beef broth and 2 tbsp red wine for the sauce

Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/16899/beef-wellington/
